predictions.prediction_text: Insiders expect bottoming after Easter, into Q3 at around last year April levels.

predictions.prediction_text: The market is significantly underpricing left-tail risk, making it vulnerable to a negative tariff surprise that could trigger a vol squeeze, black swan event, and eventual QE once prices consolidate.
predictions.expected_result: A negative tariff surprise will cause sharp market sell-off, a rapid spike in implied and realized volatility, and increase likelihood of monetary policy easing (QE) after prices stabilize
